name: app-magenta-wireframe-3d-stat-screen-with-pixel-numerals
title: Magenta Wireframe Stat Screen with Pixel Numerals
whatItIs: A phone screenshot of a year-in-review page in near-black and hot magenta: a halftone dark background, a rotating wireframe of two chunky 3D shapes, a label 'Messages sent this year', a huge pixel-font number 1759, a sentence with the key phrase on a magenta highlight block, three glyph icons and dashes for page progress with an offset arrow tile.
whatItMeans: One neon hue on black with pixel numerals feels arcade-like, and the wireframe shape gives a sense of data as an object.
techniques: Wireframe 3D objects as an abstract illustration
Giant pixel-font number as the hero stat
Highlight block behind the key phrase

vocabulary.definition: A 3D object shown only by its edges.
A typeface built from square pixels.
A very large number that is the focus of a screen.
